'''Wang Fosong''' ({{zh|c=王佛松|p=Wáng Fósōng}}; 23 May 1933 – 31 December 2022) was a Chinese polymer chemist, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Wang">{{cite news|author1=Wu Yuewei ({{lang|zh|吴跃伟}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_21388741 |script-title=zh:中科院原副院长、著名高分子化学家王佛松院士病逝，享年89岁 |work=thepaper |date=1 January 2023 |access-date=2 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

Wang was a member of the 7th National Committee of the [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]].<ref name="Wang"/> He was a member of the Standing Committees of the [[8th National People's Congress|8th]] and [[9th National People's Congress]].<ref name="Wang"/>

==Biography==
Wang was born into a family of farming background in [[Xingning, Guangdong|Xingning County, Guangdong]], on 23 May 1933.<ref name="Wang"/> In 1951, he was admitted to [[Wuhan University]], where he majored in the Department of Chemistry.<ref name="Wang"/> After graduating in 1955, he was sent to study at the [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union|Soviet Academy of Sciences]] on government scholarships, obtaining a vice-doctorate degree in 1960.<ref name="Wang"/> 

Wang returned to China in 1960 and that same year became a member of the Changchun Institute of Applied Chemistry, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Wang"/> He moved up the ranks to become assistant director in 1984 and director in 1985.<ref name="Wang"/> He rose to become vice president of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1988, a post he kept until 1994.<ref name="Wang"/> 

On 31 December 2022, Wang died in [[Beijing]], at the age of 89.<ref name="Wang"/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.bjd.com.cn/2023/01/01/10285134.shtml |script-title=zh:中国科学院原副院长王佛松逝世 |work=bjd.com.cn |date=1 January 2023 |access-date=2 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* State Natural Science Award (Second Class)<ref name="Fo">{{cite news |url=http://ecomaterials.ciac.cas.cn/kydw/yszj/ |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士 |work=ciac.cas.cn |date=2 March 2012 |access-date=2 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 1985 State Natural Science Award (Special)<ref name="Fo"/>
* 1988 State Natural Science Award (Second Class)<ref name="Fo"/>
* 1991 State Natural Science Award (Third Class)<ref name="Fo"/>
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="Wang"/>
* 2000 Fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS)<ref name="Wang"/>
* 2002 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="Fo"/>
